naslov: Nikola Jokic is reportedly not guaranteed to re-sign with the Nuggets
tekst:
By Stefan Acevski / info@eurohoops.net
Nikola Jokic has completely transformed the Denver Nuggets franchise, and he was the NBA Finals MVP in the 2023 season when Denver won their ring.
Unlike many NBA superstars, Jokic leads a different lifestyle, having settled with his family in Colorado and expressing a desire to finish his career there. He has actually emphasized this numerous times.
However, there is still a possibility that the Serbian might leave Denver, although his stay in Colorado remains very likely. This information was brought by journalist Tim Kawakami during “The TK Show”, who stated that everything is still an “open thing.”
“I’ve been hearing this for a little while. It’s an open thing. It’s an open thing. He’s very likely to go back to Denver, but it’s an open thing. There’s nothing guaranteed about him going back to sign a long extension with Denver.”
Jokic arrived in Denver in 2015, and in 11 years, he managed to win a championship ring and be the Finals MVP in 2023. He has also been the NBA Regular Season MVP three times and has participated in the All-Star Game eight consecutive times.
